Experience the electrifying dance song "Chikni Chameli" like never before in breathtaking 8K resolution! From the blockbuster film Agneepath, this high-energy track features the stunning Katrina Kaif and the charismatic Hrithik Roshan in a visual spectacle.
Song Credits:
Song – Chikni Chameli
Singer – Shreya Ghoshal
Music – Ajay Atul
Lyrics – Amitabh Bhattacharya
